name: EVERGREEN CLOTHING
address: 945 NW WALL ST STE 150, BEND, OR 97703

fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Utility Area; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Structures; Limited Side Access; Dense Vegetation; Single Access Point
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker visible from the road at the driveway entrance.
• Mark the single driveway access point clearly so responders can identify it quickly on arrival.
• Trim vegetation along the sides of the driveway to allow full-width vehicle passage.
• Clear a walking path wide enough for responders carrying equipment between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the side of the property to open at least one usable path for responders to reach the rear.
• Keep any gates or barriers along the side access route unlocked or secured with a single standard padlock.
• Mark the location of utility shutoffs with a weather-resistant label visible from ground level.
• Keep the area around utility equipment clear of stored items, tools, and vegetation.
• Designate and keep clear a flat, open area near the driveway where emergency vehicles can stage or turn around.
• Thin shrubs and low branches near the detached structure so responders can move around all sides of it.
